questions.question: What is plant stress?
questions.solution_html:
• What is plant stress? / [CO1]
  • • Plant stress refers to adverse conditions affecting plant growth.
  • • It leads to reduction in normal growth and development.
  • • Stress can cause damage to plant tissues.
  • • It is often caused by environmental factors like drought or heat.
  • • Plants respond to stress for survival.
